title: Lemon Berry Tofu Mousse
blurb: A light, creamy mousse made by blending silken tofu with honey, lemon and frozen berries. Chill before serving for the best texture.
steps: Drain the silken tofu and pat it gently with kitchen paper to remove excess moisture.
Put the tofu, frozen berries, lemon juice, honey and vanilla extract into a food processor or blender.
Blend on high speed for about two minutes until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides once if needed.
Divide the mousse between two serving bowls or glasses.
Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour before serving to let the mousse firm up and the flavours develop.
